concept.name: DDD Strategic Context Mapping

spark.summary: DDD Strategic Context Mapping is a foundational topic in System Architecture & Design. Engineers use it to make predictable trade-offs under load, failure, and evolving requirements.
spark.keyTakeaway: Adopt DDD Strategic Context Mapping when its operational assumptions match your scale, consistency needs, and team skills.

concept.whyItMatters: DDD Strategic Context Mapping influences reliability, cost, and delivery speed. Misapplying it creates outages, data bugs, or unmaintainable systems.

deepDive.markdownContent:
## DDD Strategic Context Mapping

This deep dive walks through when to apply **DDD Strategic Context Mapping**, how it interacts with adjacent patterns, and which signals prove it is working in production.

### Operating checklist

- Define success metrics and failure budgets.
- Validate behavior under partial outages.
- Keep runbooks and diagrams current for on-call engineers.

caseStudy.problem: Repeated incidents traced to gaps in DDD Strategic Context Mapping practices
caseStudy.solution: Standardized DDD Strategic Context Mapping with explicit invariants, dashboards, and game-day exercises
caseStudy.impact: Lower MTTR and fewer customer-impacting regressions
